environment.description: IoT gateway service deployed as a Kubernetes pod in a cluster with no Pod Security enforcement. Container runs as root with hostNetwork: true, allowing the attacker to co-locate a timing measurement process on the same physical host via a privileged sidecar or hostPath-mounted /proc access. The pod spec uses hostPID: true enabling direct process inspection and high-resolution timing measurements through /proc/[pid]/sched and perf_event_open syscalls.
